policy: FRESH_IMAGE_STREAMING (image-major): one live image; stores built from the arms' own T1 of the image's first dialogue -> served -> audited -> committed -> run-local scratch deleted by exact SHA256 allowlist
expected_ssd_write_note: per image: the IMPRESS-layout store (written, then rewritten in the reordered layout) and, in the gate and dev phases, the FullLoad store; sizes from the earlier main run's disk_usage.json of the same image; rows and evidence not included
deletion_scope: runs/<RUN>/<model>/scratch only (exact SHA allowlist after audit+commit; the stores of an interrupted image that cannot be verified on resume); existing stores never deleted
